items.title: 视频深度研究：迈向下一代多模态深度研究智能体
items.originalTitle: Video-DeepResearch: Towards the Next-Generation Multimodal Deepresearch Agent
items.summary: 我们提出Video-DeepResearch (Video-DR)，将多模态智能体从静态图像扩展到连续视频流。初步评估发现两个关键瓶颈：模态偏差和参数知识泄漏。我们提出解耦感知-探索流水线和阶段式工具解锁，采用监督微调和GRPO训练，并构建包含200个复杂多跳VQA实例的Video-DR-Bench。实验表明，Video-DeepResearch-35B-A3B平均准确率64.0%，超过Claude-4.5-Sonnet (59.0%) 5.0个百分点。
items.abstract: We introduce Video-DeepResearch (Video-DR), extending multimodal agents from static images to continuous video streams, a setting that demands dense spatiotemporal grounding coupled with open-web exploration. Preliminary evaluations reveal two critical bottlenecks in current models: (1) modality bias, where agents bypass visual tools in favor of textual search, and (2) parametric knowledge leakage, where models rely on internal memory rather than genuine tool-augmented execution. keyFacts: 如何将多模态智能体从静态图像扩展到连续视频流，并解决模态偏差和参数知识泄漏问题？

items.summary: 提出图像到可编辑重建任务，并构建DrawAI基准与工作流。DrawAI-Bench涵盖科学图表、幻灯片等，用39个标准混合评估保真度与可编辑性。DrawAI-Flow采用两阶段智能体工作流：解析代理生成重建计划，重建代理通过迭代循环实现可执行图形代码。评估了十三个模型与五个代理框架。
items.abstract: Recent image-generation models and multimodal agents can produce high-quality visuals for increasingly complex visual communication tasks. Yet their raster outputs remain difficult to use directly because meaningful content and relationships are flattened into pixels, preventing users from inspecting, modifying, rearranging, or reusing individual components. items.title: 利用感知的顺风车：针对多模态LLM智能体的隐蔽并发音频提示注入
items.originalTitle: Piggybacking on Perception: Stealthy Concurrent Audio Prompt Injections against Multimodal LLM Agents
items.summary: 大型语言模型驱动的多模态智能体通过连续音频交互执行自主任务，但音频输入不可避免地包含环境噪声。本文研究针对多模态智能体的并发音频提示注入攻击，提出指令增强和场景隐藏技术，使恶意音频指令隐蔽地“搭便车”到用户语音上。构建了首个音频指令注入攻击基准AudioAgentSecurity，涵盖8个真实任务场景和10种攻击模式，评估了包括Gemini 3 Pro和GPT-4o-audio在内的11个先进智能体，平均攻击成功率达69.10%。提出基于源分离和一致性分析的级联音频解耦与验证（CADV）防御机制，检测准确率高达96%。
items.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-driven multimodal agents are increasingly deployed to execute autonomous tasks via continuous audio interaction. While this paradigm enhances interaction naturalness, it introduces a critical yet under-explored attack surface, as audio inputs inevitably contain environmental noise beyond user control. In this paper, we investigate concurrent audio prompt injection attacks targeting multimodal agents. Distinct from traditional acoustic attacks on voice devices, we propose novel techniques…
keyFacts: 如何针对多模态智能体实施隐蔽的并发音频提示注入攻击，并有效防御？
提出指令增强和场景隐藏技术实现攻击；构建AudioAgentSecurity基准；提出级联音频解耦与验证（CADV）防御机制，基于源分离和一致性分析。
在11个先进智能体上平均攻击成功率达69.10%，对Gemini 3 Pro尤为有效；CADV检测准确率高达96%，能有效防御多种音频注入攻击。

items.title: LedgerMind：基于结构化证据账本的多模态智能体推理溯源约束
items.originalTitle: LEDGERMIND: Provenance-Constrained Multimodal Agentic Reasoning with a Structured Evidence Ledger
items.summary: 多模态视觉问答智能体以多步轨迹运行，但评估常仅关注最终答案准确率，掩盖了错误根源。本文提出将轨迹视为溯源约束状态机：工具输出归一化为结构化证据账本，推理和决策只能引用活跃账本条目，并在实体和数值层面检查依据，修复通过类型化状态转换实现。实例化为LedgerMind，辅以三层依据协议、自适应双路径调度器和事件触发验证修复引擎，带有正式溯源非放大保证。实验表明LedgerMind提升答案准确性和轨迹级忠实度。
items.abstract: Multimodal agents for visual question answering increasingly operate as multi-step trajectories that interleave perception, retrieval, and reasoning, yet evaluation still largely reduces to final-answer accuracy. This aggregate signal cannot tell whether a correct answer was reached through grounded evidence, language priors, or accidental error cancellation. We propose to treat a multimodal agent trajectory as a provenance-constrained state machine: tool outputs are normalized into a Structured Evidence Ledger th…
keyFacts: 如何约束多模态智能体轨迹的溯源，提升推理的忠实度而不只关注最终答案？
提出溯源约束状态机，引入结构化证据账本、三层依据协议、自适应双路径调度器和事件触发验证修复引擎。
LedgerMind在多个多模态推理基准和骨干MLLM上提升答案准确性和轨迹级忠实度。
